jersey.title: Flag of Jersey

colors.note: The saltire (Cross of St Patrick); the Plantagenet cross.

desc: - A white field with a red diagonal cross (saltire) and the badge of Jersey in the upper triangle
- The badge features the Plantagenet crown above a red shield with three golden leopards
trivia:
- Jersey uses a modified Union Jack with a cross representing St. George
- Jersey is a Crown dependency with its own government, separate from UK Parliament
- The island has its own local flag separate from the official Union Jack
